title: 第9章　结论：在新的伊斯坦布尔阅读城市权利小说
originalTitle: CHAPTER 9 Conclusion: Reading the Right to the City Novels in a New Istanbul

zh: 第9章　结论：在新的伊斯坦布尔阅读城市权利小说
en: CHAPTER 9 Conclusion: Reading the Right to the City Novels in a New Istanbul

zh: 我在本书中提出，现代土耳其小说中的某一脉络，可以被辨识为城市权利小说。这些小说都以伊斯坦布尔的迁入者为主人公，其哲学基础与城市权利相契合——这一概念由亨利·列斐伏尔在1968年5月巴黎骚乱之前不久提出。我认为，这些与城市权利概念一致的作品，可以被视为土耳其文学中怀旧伊斯坦布尔小说脉络的对位。换言之，只有存在其对立面——怀旧伊斯坦布尔小说——时，这一脉络才存在。因此，以迁入者为主人公的小说，并不能仅凭这一事实就被归入城市权利小说；它们必须与怀旧小说形成对位。相应地，这一术语不能用于以土耳其其他城市的迁入者为主人公的小说，因为在那些城市中，没有可辨识的怀旧小说脉络。
en: I have argued in this book that a certain vein within modern Turkish novels can be identified as right to the city novels. These novels all have migrant protagonists in Istanbul and their philosophical underpinnings are compatible with the right to the city, a concept developed by Henri Lefebvre just before the Paris riots of May 1968. I have argued that these works in harmony with the concept of the right to the city can be accepted as a counterpoint to the vein of nostalgic Istanbul novels in Turkish literature. In other words, this vein exists only with the presence of its antithesis which is the nostalgic Istanbul novels. Therefore, novels with migrant protagonists cannot de facto be classified as right to the city novels, they must stand as a counterpoint to nostalgic novels. Consequently, the term cannot be applied to novels with migrant protagonists in other cities of Turkey as there are no identifiable veins of nostalgic novels set in them.

zh: 城市是一个始终处于流变中的生命体。同样，城市性概念也不是一成不变的，它亦随时间演进。因此，在分析小说相关主题时，我讨论了伊斯坦布尔的变化及伴随而来的观念变化，也讨论了对城市性含义不断演变的认识。
en: The city is a living entity which is always in a state of flux. Likewise, the concept of urbanity is not written in stone, it also evolves through time. Therefore, as I analysed the related themes in the novels, I discussed the changes in Istanbul and concomitant perceptions about it, and the evolving perspectives on the meaning of urbanity.

zh: 列斐伏尔将城市权利描述为“一种更高形式的权利：自由的权利、在社会化中个体化的权利、拥有居所与栖居的权利”（1996，173）。对于一个连居所权、换言之连在城市中的正当性都遭到质疑的人，按列斐伏尔的意义栖居城市，听来几乎是乌托邦。对迁入者而言，在城市中的正当性，是栖居其中的前提。正当性问题有两个维度。
en: Lefebvre describes the right to the city as “a superior form of rights: right to freedom, to individualization in socialization, to habitat and to inhabit” (1996, 173). For a person whose right to habitat, in other words whose legitimacy in the city, is even questioned, inhabiting it in the Lefebvrian sense sounds almost utopic. For migrants, legitimacy in the city is the prerequisite for inhabiting it. The problem of legitimacy has two dimensions.

zh: 第一个维度，是迁入者的城市化。一个迁入者若要被视为城市正当的一员，就应当能够融入城市，获得城市身份。只要城市人仍把迁入者看作城里的农民，即便不把他或她视为扰乱城市氛围的不速之客，也会当作局外人。因此，迁入者的城市化，在本书分析的所有小说中，都成为重要主题。
en: The first dimension is the migrant’s urbanisation. For a migrant to be regarded as a legitimate member of the city she or he should be able to integrate into the city, adopt an urban identity. As long as the urbanites of the city perceive a migrant as a peasant in the city, they will treat him or her as an outsider if not an unwelcome visitor disturbing the urban atmosphere. The urbanisation of the migrant thus comes to the fore as an important theme in all the novels I have analysed in this book.

zh: 第二个维度，涉及迁入者在城市环境中满足需要的方式。如果说，其正当性遭质疑的一个原因，是他们不被视为城市人，那么另一个原因，就是他们的非正规生存策略所引发的不满；阿塞夫·巴亚特将这些策略描述为“普通人的静默蚕食”（2013，80）。这也正是两个维度形成恶性循环之处：迁入者必须成为城市人，才能成为城市正当的一员。然而，在基于非正规性的生活中，融入城市、获得城市身份，却更加困难。
en: The second dimension comprises migrants’ ways of meeting their needs in the urban context. If one constituent of migrants’ questioned legitimacy is the perception that they are not urbanites, the other one is the discomfort they cause with their informal strategies of survival which Asef Bayat describes as a “quiet encroachment of the ordinary” (2013, 80). This is the point where the two dimensions form a vicious circle: the migrant needs to become an urbanite to be a legitimate member of the city. However, in her or his life based on informality, integrating into the city and adopting an urban identity becomes even more challenging.

zh: 既有精英对城市性僵硬而规范性的理解，加剧了这一困境。然而，正如凯末尔·卡尔帕特所观察的，迁入者融入城市、接受城市价值观与生活方式的同时，城市也会吸收迁入者文化的某些要素；例如，民间文化会为城市氛围带来活力与色彩（2009，137—164）。承认这一事实，会使城市性的“处方”更有弹性，向包含多种另类城市性的新可能敞开。
en: This dilemma is intensified by the rigid, normative understanding of urbanity by the elite establishment. However, as Kemal Karpat observes, while the migrants integrate into the city and adopt urban values and ways of living, the city also adopts some elements of migrants’ culture, such as when folk culture brings dynamism and colour to the urban atmosphere (2009, 137–164). Appreciating this fact would result in flexibility in the ‘prescription’ of urbanity towards new possibilities that encompass multiple, alternative urbanities.

zh: 前面几章分析的七部小说，其作者通过广泛主题处理这些问题。塔希雷·埃尔曼在划分

（棚户区）研究的阶段时，将20世纪50、60年代描述为“‘乡村他者’”的时代（2001，3）。这一认识在《思乡的鸟儿》（1962）与《哈洛大叔与两头公牛》（1973）中都很明显。两书的表达，也与埃尔曼所说的70年代倾向——“处境不利的他者”——相契合（2001，3）。在《思乡的鸟儿》中，奥尔罕·凯末尔在好迁入者与坏迁入者对立的框架下，聚焦城市性问题。小说中既有投机取巧、道德败坏、力图“在城里发大财”的迁入者刻板形象，也有试图获得城市身份、正派而勤劳的迁入者。凯末尔所设想的城市化过程，符合既有精英的期待：它建立在穆拉特·贝尔盖所说的“一种西方主义—进步主义立场的理性主义与启蒙”之上（1994，223）。若采用卡尔帕特的术语，凯末尔遵循的公式是：迁入者在城市中改变，城市却不随迁入者而改变。不过，小说的表达在一个关键点上有别于精英观点。在阶级社会的等级观念中，即便迁入者已城市化，既有精英仍会将其看作城市中低人一等的成员。凯末尔明确反对这一认识，强烈强调：迁入者作为无产阶级的一部分，有潜力成为城市平等的一员。
en: The authors of the seven novels analysed in the previous chapters were addressing these problematics through a wide range of themes. In her periodisation of
(shanty) studies, Tahire Erman describes the 1950s and the 1960s as the era of “‘the rural Other’” (2001, 3). This perception is explicit in both
(1973). Their messages are also compatible with what Erman describes as the tendency of the 1970s: “the disadvantaged other” (2001, 3). In

, Orhan Kemal focuses on the question of urbanity within the framework of the good migrant–bad migrant opposition. The stereotype of the opportunistic, immoral migrant striving ‘to make it big in the city’ is present in the novel, together with the decent, hardworking migrant who is trying to adopt an urban identity. The process of urbanity Kemal envisions is compatible with the expectations of the elite establishment: it is based on what Murat Belge describes as “the rationalism and enlightenment of a Westernist-progressivist stance” (1994, 223). If we apply Karpat’s terms, Kemal follows the formula where the migrant changes in the city, yet the city does not change with the migrant. That said, the novel’s messages differ from the elite view in a crucial way. Within the hierarchical perceptions of the class-based society, the elite establishment will see the migrant as an inferior member of the city even after she or he is urbanised. Kemal takes a clear stance against this perception, placing strong emphasis on the migrant’s potential to be an equal member of the city as part of the proletariat.

zh: 在《哈洛大叔与两头公牛》中，主人公只是暂时待在城里，因此迁入者的城市化不是主要问题。穆扎费尔·伊兹居通过公民身份问题，集中讨论农民与那个被称为“国家”的实体之间的关系。他没有为城市化开处方，也没有呈现任何理想的迁入者：小说中留在城市的人物，在多个方面符合腐化的迁入者刻板形象。伊兹居不把城市化作为理想提出，因此也不追问城市性的定义；由此，小说对于迁入者能否不丧失自身价值观而融入城市，表达并不明确。书中的迁入者在城市里学会了自私，甚至狡诈。城市夺去了他们封建价值观中的积极方面，却并未真正提供新价值观作为回应。将这一点与伊兹居对乡村生活的积极态度——尽管乡村生活充满挑战——结合起来，可以在作品中发现：对于该国农民，即潜在迁入者，他更偏好乡村生活，而非城市生活。
en: Urbanisation of the migrant is not a major issue in

where the protagonist is in the city temporarily. Muzaffer İzgü concentrates on the relationship between peasants and that entity called ‘the state’ through the question of citizenship. He does not give a prescription for urbanisation, nor does he present any ideal migrants: the migrant characters in the novel who stay in the city fit the corrupt migrant stereotype in various ways. As İzgü does not propose urbanisation as an ideal, he does not question the definition of urbanity, hence the novel’s unclear message on whether it is possible for migrants to integrate into the city without losing their values. The migrant characters in the book learn to be selfish if not cunning in the city. The city takes the positive aspects of their feudal values but does not really offer new values in response. When this fact comes together with İzgü’s positive approach to life in the countryside despite all its challenges, it is possible to find in this work a preference for rural over urban life for the peasants of the country (i.e., potential migrants).

zh: 随着《垃圾山的故事》（1984）来到20世纪80年代，我们能够看到卡尔帕特所概括的迁入者与城市的相互改变，以及这一过程可能带来的另类城市性的意涵。拉蒂费·泰金不仅通过人物塑造或故事反映这一立场，也运用口头传统中的哀歌、谜语、歌曲等民间文化要素。正如萨利哈·帕克尔指出的，以这种风格，泰金用“‘被剥夺者的语言’”写作小说；它“不仅表达他们的生活方式，也表达其人生观、对现实的感知、幽默感和梦想”（2004，12）。如此一来，泰金突出另类城市性的可能：迁入者可以在其中保留民间文化的多种要素。她没有为城市化提供处方，只是邀请读者超越既有范式与关于城市性的处方去思考。
en: When we come to the 1980s with

(1984) we are able to see what Karpat summarises as a mutual change between the migrant and the city as well as the implications of alternative urbanities such a process might lead to. Latife Tekin does not reflect this stance simply through characterisation or story but by utilising elements of folk culture such as laments, riddles and songs of the oral tradition. With such a style, as Saliha Paker points out, Tekin writes this novel in “‘a language of the deprived’, one that gives expression not only to their way of life but also to their outlook on life, perception of reality, sense of humour and dreams” (2004, 12). Doing that, Tekin accentuates the possibility of alternative urbanities where migrants can preserve various elements of their folk culture. She does not offer a prescription of urbanisation, just invites her readers to think beyond the existing paradigms and the prescriptions regarding urbanity.

zh: 《重罗曼》（1995）把城市性问题置于中心，并以极为独特的方式将其问题化。在这部

中，可被视为第二代迁入者的梅廷·卡钱，描绘了能够成为城市人的迁入者与未能成为城市人的迁入者之间的对立。卡钱明确表明：只要珍视城市给予他们的东西，迁入者或迁入者的孩子就是城市人。全书的这一表达，尤其与其场景相联系：科莱拉，一个“衰败街区”、一个“贫民窟”，或者对偏爱委婉说法的人来说，一个“内城”。卡钱将这个离佩拉区仅两分钟步行距离、被污名化的贫困街区，创造为一个多样性达到极致的宇宙。街区过去属于非穆斯林少数族群，他们留下的遗产与遗迹，是科莱拉的核心特征与价值。享受这种多样性的居民，对自己的街区有深厚依恋。只要忠于科莱拉人身份与共同体价值，妓女、吸毒者和轻罪犯，也都被包括在科莱拉世界主义的团结之中。通过主人公格利的形象，把科莱拉人身份展开为一种城市身份，处于全书的正中心：格利是一个（第二代）迁入者，以自己的方式把城市作为
来欣赏，随时赞叹它的老建筑、教堂、鹅卵石街道，以及它带来的多样性。格利生活于一种接近列斐伏尔所说栖居城市的状态。
en: (1995) is a novel where the issue of urbanity is central and problematised in a highly unique manner. In this work, Metin Kaçan, who can be regarded as a second-generation migrant, depicts an opposition between migrants who could become urbanites and those who could not. Kaçan makes it clear that migrants or children of migrants are urbanites as long as they appreciate what the city offers to them. This message of the book is notably connected with its setting: Kolera, a ‘deteriorated neighbourhood’, a ‘slum’ or the ‘inner-city’ for those who prefer this euphemism. Kaçan creates this stigmatised poor neighbourhood, just a two-minute walk from the Pera district, as a universe where diversity is at its highest. The legacy and the remnants of the non-Muslim minorities, to whom the neighbourhood belonged in the past, is a central characteristic and value of Kolera. Dwellers who enjoy the diversity here have a strong attachment to their neighbourhood. The cosmopolitan solidarity in Kolera encompasses prostitutes, drug addicts and petty criminals as long as they are loyal to the Kolerite identity and the values of the community. The elaboration of the Kolerite identity as an urban identity is at the very heart of the book through the portrayal of its protagonist Gıli: a (second-generation) migrant who, in his own way, appreciates the city as
, admiring its old buildings, churches, cobblestoned streets at every turn, and the diversity it offers. Gıli lives in a state close to what Lefebvre describes as inhabiting the city.
body.review: 本章此处及后文均将《重罗曼》标为1995年；本章书目却列1999［1990］。正文年份照底本保留。

zh: 正如埃尔曼所观察的，从20世纪80年代中期至90年代中期，棚户区研究将棚户居民视为“‘城市贫困他者’”，与“‘不值得同情的他者’及‘作为亚文化的文化低劣他者’”相对照（2001，3）。《垃圾山的故事》清楚地指涉了这一认识。《重罗曼》并不以棚户区为背景，所以埃尔曼的观察并不完全适用。然而，她观察到的认识，在许多方面也适用于科莱拉这类市中心贫困街区的迁入者。
en: During the period from the middle of the 1980s to the middle of the 1990s, as Erman observes, shanty dwellers were perceived as “‘the urban poor Other(s)’ versus ‘the undeserving Other(s)’ and ‘the culturally inferior Other(s) as sub-culture’” (2001, 3) in shanty studies. References to this perception are clear in
. Since

is not set in a shanty town, Erman’s observation is not entirely relevant to it. Yet, the perception she observes is in many ways valid for migrants in poor neighbourhoods of the city centre, such as Kolera, as well.

zh: 《在边缘》（2003）主要以20世纪90年代末为背景，通过倒叙描绘早期几十年的迁移与棚户生活。在故事发生的90年代，迁入者的城市化已不再是广泛讨论的话题。棚屋已不复存在，将其称为城中村庄、将居民称为城中农民的倾向，也随之消失。1984至1987年的特赦法之后，低质量公寓楼取代棚屋，旧棚户区在公众观念中成了
——一个用于描述边缘街区的贬义词。埃尔曼于2001年写作时，将90年代末棚户区研究中的认识定义为“具有威胁性的／

居民］他者”（2001，3）。换言之，隐藏在城市人与乡村迁入者分野中的正当性问题，在这一时期变得更加明确：生活在边缘的人让中心居民感到受威胁，因此几乎事实上被否认了正当性。在《在边缘》中，艾汉·盖奇金强调，迁入者——大多是第二代——缺乏参与市中心生活的机会。他描绘，住在城市边缘旧棚户区的迁入者，前往市中心时如何感到脱节，因为缺少能将他们纳入中心的社会网络与机制，例如休闲中心、文化和体育协会、社区中心。当偏远地区的迁入者试图靠自己的办法体验市中心生活时，他们担心被看作“具有威胁性的／
他者”。虽然盖奇金关注的是边缘居民需要在市中心交往的机会，而不是这一问题，但他把城市描绘为阴郁、不欢迎人的地方，其中也可以发现对这类歧视性话语的指涉。
en: In

(2003), which is mainly set in the late 1990s, the early decades of migration and shanty life are illustrated through flashbacks. In the 1990s, when the story is set, the urbanisation of the migrant is no longer a widely discussed topic. As the shanties no longer exist, the tendency for describing them as villages in the city, and migrants living there as peasants in the city, is no longer present. As poor-quality apartments replaced the shanties after the Amnesty Acts of 1984–1987, in the public perception the former shanty towns became the
, a pejorative term used to describe periphery neighbourhoods. Erman, writing in 2001, defines the perception in shanty studies in the late 1990s as “the threatening/

dweller] Other” (2001, 3). In other words, the problem of legitimacy hidden in the divide between urbanites and rural migrants becomes more explicit at that period as those living in the periphery are almost de facto denied legitimacy, since they make those at the centre of the city feel threatened. In

, Ayhan Geçgin lays emphasis on the lack of opportunities for migrants, mostly second-generation, to be a part of the life of the city centre. He illustrates how migrants living in the peripheral former shanty towns feel disconnected when visiting the city centre due to the lack of social networks and mechanisms such as leisure centres, cultural and sportive associations, and community centres that could incorporate them into the centre. When migrants living in the remote parts of the city try to experience life in the city centre by their own means they are worried about being perceived as “the threatening/

Other”. Although Geçgin focuses on the periphery inhabitants’ need for opportunities to socialise in the city centre rather than this problem, in the way he depicts the city as a grim and unwelcoming place it is possible to find reference to such discriminatory discourses as well.

zh: 《人各有别》（2008）以21世纪头十年为背景，我们看到其中作为流氓无产阶级成员的迁入者，指涉了“具有威胁性的／
他者”。梅里耶姆在小说中，将消费主义价值观强加于这些被隔绝在边缘的穷人的过程问题化。主人公现实地体现了这样一位棚户区女性：如今住在取代棚屋的公寓里，努力通过消费实现城市化。
en: In
(2008), set in the 2000s, we see references to the “threatening/

Other” with migrants as members of the lumpen proletariat. In her novel, Meryem problematises the imposition of consumerist values on these poor people isolated on the periphery. The protagonist is a realistic portrayal of a shanty-town woman, now living in an apartment that replaced the shanty, who strives to urbanise through consumption.

zh: 在棚户时期，棚户区女性以消费主义向往作为获得城市身份的方式，是重要现象。女性棚户居民被置于“一种以消费为导向的价值体系”之下，深受其苦；它“导致无尽的渴求、未获满足的欲望、对自身阶级的疏离”（Şenyapılı 1981，207）。那时，女性棚户居民到中产阶级家中做清洁，得以一窥其生活。然而，在今天的旧棚户区中，她们不断面对步行可及的中产阶级公寓。在小说所处的21世纪头十年的伊斯坦布尔，棚屋已不存在，封闭式社区与许多城市边缘的旧棚户区毗邻。此外，今天的收入不平等，比迁移较早几十年的棚户时期更加严重。这一切使上述渴求更难应对。
en: Consumerist aspirations of women in shanty towns as a way of adopting an urban identity was a significant phenomenon during the shanty period. Female shanty dwellers suffered from being subjected to “a consumption oriented value system which leads to endless cravings, unsatisfied desires, alienation from one’s own class” (Şenyapılı 1981, 207). During that period, female shanty dwellers got a glimpse of the lives of the middle class in the houses they went to clean. In the former shanty towns of today, however, they are constantly exposed to the middle-class apartments that are within walking distance. In the Istanbul of the 2000s when the novel is set, shanties exist no more and gated communities border on many of the former shanty towns on the fringes of the city. In addition to that, income inequality is greater today than it was during the shanty period in the earlier decades of migration. All these render the mentioned cravings much more difficult to handle.

zh: 哈蒂杰·梅里耶姆将一座购物中心放在《人各有别》的中心，作为消费主义和城市性的象征。科兹卢克年轻人将这座购物中心用作交往场所。这里没有街区灵魂，没有世界主义的团结。然而，梅里耶姆并未把这描写为走向虚无主义；相反，她强调迁入者及其孩子克服重重困难、在城市里生存下去的坚韧。小说结束于博斯普鲁斯大桥之上，迁入者人物欣赏壮丽景色；她由此将他们从边缘带到伊斯坦布尔中心，并以对他们所承受艰难的敬意，暗示他们凭自身的城市性方式，在城市中具有正当性。
en: Hatice Meryem places a shopping mall at the centre of

as a symbol of consumerism, and of urbanity. This mall is used by the youngsters of Kozluk as a place for socialisation. There is no neighbourhood soul, no cosmopolitan solidarity. Yet Meryem does not depict this as leading to nihilism; instead she accentuates migrants’ and their children’s perseverance to survive in the city against all odds. As she ends her novel at the top of the Bosporus Bridge with the migrant characters enjoying the stunning view, she brings them from the periphery to the centre of Istanbul; and revering all the hardship they endure she implies their legitimacy in the city with their own modes of urbanity.

zh: 在研究语料的最后一部小说《我脑袋里的怪东西》（2014）中，我们遇到一位试图以独特方式栖居城市的迁入者主人公。麦夫鲁特是个独特的人物，是一个爱上伊斯坦布尔的迁入者。他没有像

那样漫步城市的观念；然而，他的一生确实作为街头小贩漫步城中。他如此享受行走，以致即使另有谋生职业，也仍为快乐而沿街叫卖。帕慕克将麦夫鲁特塑造成一个获得城市身份的人物；这种身份并非既有体制所规定，甚至可能根本超出其想象。他这个迁入者，对城市美与遗产的珍视程度，是许多老城市人永远做不到的；从这个意义上，他比那些自以为有权决定谁是、谁不是城市人，谁是、谁不是城市正当成员的人，更像城市人。作家奥尔罕·帕慕克属于城市既有居民的精英阶层；在这部作品之前，他描写与自身背景相近者的生活，有时带怀旧语调，有时没有。他将对城市的深情置于创作的中心。《我脑袋里的怪东西》把这种深情表现为迁入者的感受，帕慕克由此提出多样的另类城市性的可能，并以令人深受启发的方式处理正当性问题。
en: In

(2014), the final novel of the corpus, we meet a migrant protagonist who tries to inhabit the city in his own unique way. Mevlut is an idiosyncratic character, a migrant who is in love with Istanbul. He does not have a concept of strolling through the city like a

does; however, he does spend his life strolling through the city as a street vendor. He enjoys these strolls so much that even when he has other occupations to earn a living he continues vending for pleasure. Pamuk portrays Mevlut as a character who adopts an urban identity that is not prescribed, and probably would never be imagined, by the establishment. He is a migrant who values the beauty and heritage of the city to the extent that many of the old urbanites would never be able to do; in this sense he is more of an urbanite than those who claim the right to decide who is an urbanite and who is not, and who is a legitimate member of the city and who is not. The author Orhan Pamuk, a member of the elite segment of the established urbanites of the city, who until this work depicted the lives of people with similar backgrounds to his own, sometimes with a tone of nostalgia, sometimes not, places a deep devotion to the city at the heart of his output. Presenting this devotion to the city as it is felt by a migrant in
, Pamuk suggests the possibility of alternative, multiple urbanities; and by doing that he approaches the legitimacy issue in an inspiring manner.

zh: 然而，小说并未表明帕慕克对国内流离失所的库尔德人或外国移民等城市新来者的立场。这些新来者遭遇的氛围敌意更深，生活比前几十年的乡村迁入者艰难得多。在过去与当下迁入者的对照中，可以感到小说对新迁入者的隐含排斥。麦夫鲁特被塑造成一个成为城市人的迁入者，因而是新的伊斯坦布尔人；可当他看见20世纪90年代和21世纪头十年之后来到城市的新迁入者时，却感到异化。此时，拥有世界主义团结的棚户区已只是记忆，严重的收入不平等日益恶化。帕慕克结束全书时，主人公忧虑地观察这些陌生人，却没有暗示他们成为城市正当成员的潜力。读者透过麦夫鲁特的眼睛看他们，会觉得无论他们多么努力摆脱城市贫困陷阱，似乎都注定只能是城市的局外人。
en: However, in the novel, Pamuk does not disclose his stance on newcomers to the city like internally displaced Kurds or foreign migrants. These new arrivals encounter a much more hostile atmosphere where life is far harsher than it was for the rural migrants a couple of decades previously. In the contrast between the migrants of the past and the migrants of today an implicit exclusion of these new migrants can be felt in the novel. Mevlut, who is portrayed as a migrant who becomes an urbanite, therefore a new Istanbulite, feels alienated when he sees the new migrants who have come to the city after the 1990s and the 2000s at a time when shanty towns with a cosmopolitan solidarity are only a memory, and gross income inequality is worsening each passing day. Pamuk ends the book where its protagonist observes these unfamiliar people with concern, yet without implication as to their potential to be legitimate members of the city. As the reader looks at them through Mevlut’s eyes, they seem almost destined to be the outsiders of the city no matter how much they strive to get out of the urban poverty trap.

zh: 在转向正当性问题与迁入者生存策略的关联之前，不妨简要谈谈城市化过程的性别维度。《思乡的鸟儿》的结尾发生在主人公梅梅德与妻子艾谢所住棚户区被拆之时；丈夫望着化为废墟的棚屋，悲痛欲绝，艾谢对他说：“我们再盖，我们再盖一间！”（372）。小说让迁入女性说出这些表明留在城市、在其中生存之决心的话，是重要细节，与贝尔克泰将女性描述为“迁移的火车头”非常契合（2019，第93分钟）。在《我脑袋里的怪东西》中，受高等教育的是麦夫鲁特的女儿法特玛，而非她的男性堂亲。同一部小说还向我们介绍一位迁入女性，她在前往中产阶级家庭做清洁的途中，体验并赞叹城市的节奏与活力。在《重罗曼》中，科莱拉有些女人与男人一样经常在户外活动。她们具有科莱拉人身份——一种城市身份；相较之下，被“锁”在家中的第一代迁入者的妻子，则被描写为乡村妇女。在《在边缘》中，盖奇金强调，在城市环境里，那些必须竭尽全力满足父权制期待的迁入女性，其生活并没有太多改变。泰金在《垃圾山的故事》中，现实地描绘城市生活如何鼓励女性说出自己的需要，例如爱情与情欲等情感需要，以及她们在这方面取得任何收获有多困难。她还讨论城市环境中的消费主义痴迷，强调女性在这方面的脆弱。同样，在《人各有别》中，梅里耶姆成功描写迁入女性在渴望获得城市身份时，如何受到消费资本主义机制的操纵。
en: Before moving on to the correlation between the problem of legitimacy and migrants’ survival strategies, a brief note on the gender dimension of the urbanisation process might be useful. The closure of

is set during the demolishing of the shanty town where the protagonist Memed and his wife Ayşe live, ending with Ayşe’s words to her devastated husband as he stares at their shanty in ruins: “we will build again, we will build another one!” (372). It is an important detail that, in the novel, these words manifesting migrants’ determination to stay and survive in the city are uttered by the migrant woman, very much in line with Berktay’s description of women as the “locomotive of migration” (2019, minute 93). In

, Mevlut’s daughter, Fatma, is the one who has a higher education rather than her male cousins. Again in this novel, we are introduced to a migrant woman who admires the rhythm and liveliness of the city which she experiences on her way to the middle-class houses she cleans. In

some women in Kolera are outdoors as much as men. These are women with Kolerite identity, which is an urban identity, while the wives of first-generation migrants who are ‘locked’ indoors are portrayed as peasant women. In

, Geçgin emphasises that, in the urban context, not much changes in the lives of migrant women who must exert themselves to the utmost to meet the expectations of patriarchy. Tekin realistically illustrates in

how urban life encourages women to be vocal about their needs, for instance emotional needs such as love and sensuality, and how difficult it is to achieve any sort of gain in this regard. She also addresses consumerist obsessions in the urban context, accentuating women’s vulnerability in this respect. Similarly, in
, Meryem successfully depicts migrant women’s manipulation by the apparatuses of consumer capitalism in their aspiration to adopt an urban identity.

zh: 如上所述，迁入者正当性问题的另一面，是他们的生存策略。在大规模迁移时期，城市中的乡村迁入者主要通过非正规方式，满足住房、就业和交通等需要。如前所述，巴亚特将这些策略定义为“穷人通过蚕食重新占取公共空间”（2012，120）。迁入者也务实地利用政治（Karpat 2009，44）。他们清楚知道选票的价值，以此获得资源，例如为棚户区争取市政服务。满足城市需要的第三种方式，是城市运动；棚户运动就是极佳的例子。许克吕·阿斯兰解释，除了激进左翼势力强大的棚户区，也有由左翼团体建立的棚户区（电子邮件通信，2016年7月2日）。然而，从宏观尺度看，它们数量相当少。棚户居民只有在惯常方法无效时，才在左翼团体支持下选择激进行动（Karpat 2009，200）。正如卡尔帕特观察的，棚户迁入人口确实实施集体行动，但主要是运用网络与政治参与（43—44）。克赖将这种对网络的运用称为“庇护依附关系”，强调它是迁入者满足需要的重要工具（2007，185）。因此，迁入者被贴上机会主义者的标签。然而，卡尔帕特认为，鉴于治安力量、城市既有居民、有时还有媒体对迁入者的敌意，被如此贴标签的策略实际上不可避免（2009，43）。非正规性及其伴随的庇护依附关系与机会主义，使迁入者的正当性问题更复杂。这是一个恶性循环：迁入者遭遇的敌意越多，就越不得不依靠机会主义策略；越这样做，遭遇的敌意又越多。
en: As outlined above, on the other side of the problem of migrants’ legitimacy lie their survival strategies. During the mass migration era, rural migrants in the city predominantly met their needs such as housing, employment and transport through informal methods. As discussed earlier, Bayat defines such strategies as “reclamation, by the poor people, of public space through encroachment” (2012, 120). Migrants also made pragmatic use of politics (Karpat 2009, 44). They were well aware of the value of their votes which they utilised to access resources, such as obtaining municipal services for their shanty towns. A third way for the migrants to meet their needs in the city was urban movements. The shanty movement was a perfect example of that. As Şükrü Aslan explains, there were shanty towns formed by left-wing groups in addition to those where the radical left was strong (email comm., 2 July 2016). However, their number was quite low, considered from the macroscale. Shanty dwellers chose radical action with the support of leftist groups only when their usual methods yielded no result (Karpat 2009, 200). As Karpat observes, the migrant population of shanties did implement collective action, but this was mainly by using networks and political participation (43–44). Kıray describes this utilisation of networks as “clientelism” and stresses that it was a significant tool for migrants in meeting their needs (2007, 185). Consequently, migrants were labelled opportunists. However, Karpat contends that strategies labelled as such were inevitable given the hostility of the security forces, established residents of the city and, at times, the media against migrants (2009, 43). Informality and concomitant clientelism and opportunism made the problem of migrants’ legitimacy more complicated. This was a vicious circle: the more hostility migrants faced, the more they had to adhere to opportunistic strategies, and the more they did that, the more hostility they faced.

zh: 城市权利小说现实地处理了迁入者在城市中的生存策略问题。事实上，迁入者主要采用静默蚕食策略；他们利用政治参与和庇护依附关系；有时这些渠道受阻，便参与城市运动。所分析小说的作者，依照真实经验描写这些策略，而不创造可能被读作行动号召的替代情境。
en: This issue of migrants’ survival strategies in the city is realistically addressed in the right to the city novels. Factually, migrants predominantly followed the strategy of quiet encroachment; they made use of political participation and clientelism; and sometimes they became involved in urban movements when these channels were blocked. The authors of the analysed novels depict these strategies in line with the real experiences rather than creating alternative scenarios that could be read as a call for action.

zh: 《思乡的鸟儿》（1962）将非正规住房作为重要主题。书中现实地描写棚屋拆除，居民对拆除的抵抗中，可以找到对历史上棚户运动的指涉。在《哈洛大叔与两头公牛》（1973）中，棚户住房作为场景出现，并未作为主题深入展开。两部作品里，建筑工地的非正规就业都是迁入者的主要工作形式。在《垃圾山的故事》（1984）中，泰金以魔幻现实主义风格，将棚户区创造为平行宇宙。居民要求市政服务的集体行动，在故事中占有分量。泰金讽刺地描写激进左翼对棚户居民的兴趣与接近方式：他们意图将居民的集体行动纳入有组织的政治运动。她强调，左翼未能找到一种不会使棚户共同体感到疏离的语言。与《垃圾山的故事》一样，《重罗曼》（1995）以高度政治化的20世纪70年代为背景，也指涉左翼团体使科莱拉居民政治化的努力。街区中一些人同情左翼观点，却未由此走向激进行动。《在边缘》（2003）中，大规模迁移时期来到城市的迁入者，在工业部门获得正规就业。然而，工厂不为雇员提供工人住宅区，因此住房需要靠非正规方式——棚屋——来满足。《人各有别》（2008）中，正规就业对人物而言几乎只是梦想：整个科兹卢克，只有一个人的雇主为她缴纳社会保险。主人公勇敢地向来访政治人物反映基础设施问题，梅里耶姆由此现实地处理棚户居民对民主参与的信念。沿街叫卖是最常见的非正规就业形式，也是巴亚特所概念化的静默蚕食的典型例子，它处于《我脑袋里的怪东西》（2014）的中心。搭建棚屋与棚户生活，也在全书中得到详细描绘。帕慕克现实地处理了20世纪70年代棚户区之间的政治两极化，尤其描写了1977年4月虚构棚户区桑树山与灰山的冲突：前者由右翼逊尼派主导，后者由左翼土耳其与库尔德阿列维派主导。作品也指涉五一街区，即70年代后半期在伊斯坦布尔由左翼团体领导建立的棚户区。
en: In

(1962), informal housing comes to the fore as an important theme. In this book, there is a realistic depiction of shanty demolitions. Here, in the shanty town dwellers’ resistance to the demolition, a reference to historical shanty movements can be found. Shanty housing appears in
(1973) as a setting without much elaboration of the issue as a theme. In both books, informal employment on building sites is the main form of work for migrants. In

(1984), Tekin creates the shanty town as a parallel universe through a magical realist style. Here, the collective action of the shanty dwellers in their demands for municipal services has weight in the story. In the novel, Tekin sarcastically illustrates the radical left’s interest in and approach to the shanty dwellers with the intention of incorporating their collective action into an organised political movement. She lays emphasis on the Left’s failure to find a language that would not alienate the shanty community. Like

(1995) is set during the highly political 1970s, and contains references to the left-wing groups’ efforts to politicise the inhabitants of Kolera. Some members of the neighbourhood sympathise with left-wing views, yet these tendencies do not culminate in radical action. In

(2003) migrants who arrive in the city during the mass-migration period are employed formally in the industrial sector. Yet, since these factories do not supply their employees with workers’ estates, the housing need is met informally through shanties. In

(2008), formal employment is almost a dream for the characters: in the entire Kozluk there is only one person whose employer pays her social security taxes. In this work, Meryem realistically addresses shanty dwellers’ belief in democratic participation in the protagonist’s brave encounter with a politician visiting the neighbourhood, as she complains to him about the infrastructural problems. Vending on the streets, the most common form of informal employment and a perfect example of quiet encroachment as conceptualised by Bayat, is at the centre of

(2014). Shanty-building and shanty life are also depicted in detail throughout the work. Pamuk realistically addresses the political polarisation between shanty towns in the 1970s, particularly with the portrayal of the clash, in April 1977, between the imaginary shanty towns of Duttepe and Kültepe: the former dominated by right-wing Sunnis, and the latter by left-wing Turkish and Kurdish Alevis. In the work there is also a reference to the 1st of May Neighbourhood, a shanty town established under the leadership of leftist groups in the second half of the 1970s in Istanbul.

zh: 因此，这些小说没有传递这样一种信息：城市迁入者是一支能够通过城市行动主义改变城市生活的潜在力量。在全部研究作品中，基于静默蚕食的非正规策略——首先是通过搭建棚屋蚕食土地——都处于迁入者生活的中心。这些策略使正当性问题复杂化：迁入者依赖不被承认为正当的谋生手段，因而被视为不具正当性的城市成员。这一点以不同的明确程度，出现在所有受分析的小说中。
en: Consequently, the novels do not convey the message that migrants in the city are a potential force who can change urban life through urban activism. In all the works in the corpus, informal strategies based on quiet encroachment—primarily, encroachment on land by building shanties—are at the centre of migrants’ lives. Such strategies complicate the legitimacy question: as migrants rely on illegitimate means of survival, they are regarded as illegitimate members of the city. This point is present in all the analysed novels with varying degrees of explicitness.

zh: 20世纪90年代之后，正当性问题变得更复杂、更棘手。正如埃尔曼观察的，旧棚户区居民开始被视为“具有威胁性的／varoslu他者”（2001，3）。收入不平等日益增加，加重了穷人所经历的隔绝，这种污名化也随之不断强化。努尔丹·居尔比莱克所描述的那个“城市贫困尚未与危险或犯罪，而是与无辜联系在一起的氛围”（2005，64），早已不复存在。
en: The legitimacy issue took a more complex and problematic form after the 1990s. As Erman observes, the inhabitants of the former shanty towns started to be regarded as “the threatening/varoslu Other” (2001, 3). This stigmatisation becomes stronger with each passing day as the increasing income inequality worsens the isolation the poor experience. The times that Nurdan Gürbilek describes as “the climate when urban poverty was not yet associated with danger or crime, but with innocence” (2005, 64) are long gone.

zh: 在本书中，我尝试在艺术与生活之间的空间，探索城市权利这一哲学概念，在选定小说语料中追踪它。正如马克·奥热指出的，“艺术必须表达社会［……］，但必须有意识地去做。它不能只是被动的表达”（2008，xxi）。奥热补充，如果艺术希望呈现超出人们日常生活和媒体所见的东西，那么“它必须具有表达性和反思性”（xxi）。认识这些迁入者主人公，跟随他们在各自故事世界中的经验，会使我们获得日常直接观察或关注新闻无法提供的洞见。奥热又说，艺术家试图“处理表达与反思之间的这一间隙”（xxi）。分析这些小说时，我试图剖析每位作者如何在作品中尝试处理这一间隙。
en: In this book, I have attempted to explore a certain philosophical concept, namely the right to the city, in the space between art and life, tracking it in the selected corpus of novels. As Marc Augé points out, “art has to express society [...] but it has to do it deliberately. It cannot be simply a passive expression” (2008, xxi). Augé adds that if art aims to show something beyond what people see in their daily lives and through the media, then “it has to be expressive and reflexive” (xxi). Meeting these migrant protagonists and following their experiences in their respective story worlds offer us insights which we cannot gain by direct observations in daily life or by following the news. Augé adds that the artist tries to “manage this gap between expression and reflexiveness” (xxi). Analysing these novels, I have tried to dissect how each author attempted to achieve managing this gap in her or his work.

zh: 最后，我想从文化唯物主义角度补充：社会语境影响文化艺术产品，反过来也一样；这些产品同样影响社会语境。要具体分析读者反应，需要对具有代表性的读者群体进行调查和深入交谈，但仅通过可观察的事实，也能对读者反应形成某些认识。这些事实能让我们理解文学如何中介现实。
en: Finally, I would like to add from a cultural materialist perspective that, while the social context influences cultural and artistic products, the opposite is also true: these products also influence the social context. While a concrete analysis of reader response would require surveys and in-depth conversations with a representative group of readers, it is possible to have some ideas on reader response simply through observable facts. These facts can give us an idea on how literature mediates reality.

zh: 在《垃圾山的故事》和《重罗曼》这两部以内部人经验为基础的有力小说中，迁入者为自己发声。拉蒂费·泰金与梅廷·卡钱写出这些广受赞誉的作品，证明迁入者不只是城市中的劳动力，也可以作为小说家或其他类型艺术家，成为城市社会肌理的一部分，描绘独特的城市生活图景。从这个意义上，他们以作品，也以自己作为个体的存在方式，证明了多样／另类城市身份的可能。同样基于内部人经验的《在边缘》，是这一类别中一部引人深思的作品。《垃圾山的故事》与《重罗曼》是无声者的声音，人物取自未受正规教育的人群；两书的生活知识来自经验。《在边缘》中，我们看到这种内部人视角与来自正规教育的知识相结合。
en: In
and

, two powerful novels based on insiders’ experience, migrants speak for themselves. Latife Tekin and Metin Kaçan, writing these acclaimed books, proved that migrants were not simply the labour force in the city, that they could also be part of the urban social fabric as novelists, or as other types of artists, who could paint a unique picture of urban life. In this sense, they proved the possibility of multiple/alternative urban identities with their work as well as with the way they are as individuals.
, which is also based on insiders’ experience, is an intriguing work in this category.
and
are the voice of the voiceless, with their characters inspired by people with no formal education. The knowledge of life in these books comes from experience. In
we see a combination of this insiders’ perspective with knowledge that comes from formal education.

zh: 《思乡的鸟儿》一直是土耳其关于乡城迁移最受欢迎的文本之一。《哈洛大叔与两头公牛》也受到关注：它在三十五年间重印八次，并于初版六年后的1979年改编为电视剧。
两书都为读者提供了与乡村迁入者共情的机会。梅里耶姆在《人各有别》中，将“
”问题带入文学议程。通过讲述两个生活在边缘的女人的故事，她邀请读者质疑针对所谓
及其居民的主导污名化、歧视性话语。
en: has always been one of the most popular texts about rural–urban migration in Turkey.
has also been received with interest: it has been reprinted eight times over the course of thirty-five years, and was adapted into a television drama in 1979, six years after its first publication.
Both books offered an opportunity for readers to empathise with rural migrants. In
, Meryem brought the subject of ‘
’ to the literary agenda. Telling the story of two women living on the periphery, she invited her readers to question the dominant stigmatising and discriminating discourse about the so-called
and their people.

zh: 《我脑袋里的怪东西》像帕慕克所有小说一样，在国内和国际上都引起关注。在这部作品之前，帕慕克是一位书写老伊斯坦布尔人的作家。此书却出人意料地将一个新的伊斯坦布尔人，一个乡村迁入者，置于作品中心。全书的主要表达是：那些被老伊斯坦布尔人鄙视为侵占城市的乡村迁入者，可能以许多老伊斯坦布尔人永远无法做到的方式，热爱、欣赏，并因而属于伊斯坦布尔。当然，持犬儒眼光的人可能从这一姿态中发现一种“势利的谦逊”，并认为帕慕克作为真正的伊斯坦布尔人，自认有权决定谁属于伊斯坦布尔、伊斯坦布尔又属于谁。针对这种论点为帕慕克辩护，超出了本书范围。不管怎样，无论如何看待，麦夫鲁特这样的人物进入帕慕克的虚构人物殿堂，都是反对反迁入者偏见的重要一步。
en: , like all Pamuk novels, has aroused interest both at the national and the international scale. Until this work, Pamuk was an author who wrote about old Istanbulites. With this book, he made an unexpected move by putting a new Istanbulite, a rural migrant, at the centre of his work. The primary message of the book is that rural migrants, who were despised by old Istanbulites for having invaded the city, could love and appreciate and therefore belong to Istanbul in a way that many old Istanbulites would never be able to. Certainly, one with a cynical perspective can find a ‘snobbish modesty’ in this gesture, and argue that Pamuk, as a genuine Istanbulite, finds in himself the authority to decide who belongs to Istanbul and to whom it belongs. To defend Pamuk against such an argument is beyond the scope of this book. In any case, whichever way one views it, the participation of a character such as Mevlut in the pantheon of Pamuk’s fictional characters is an important step in the fight against anti-migrant prejudice.

zh: 总之，这些小说的作者从迁入者视角处理迁移经验，描写他们为何、如何、在怎样的条件下努力依附于城市，使他们变得可见，并唤起读者的共情。作者们也邀请读者质疑那种将一切城市问题与迁入者到来联系起来的怀旧话语。
en: In sum, addressing the migration experience from the perspective of migrants, authors of these novels render them visible and encourage feelings of empathy in their readers by depicting why, how and under which conditions migrants try to cling to the city. They also invite their readers to question the nostalgic discourse which correlates all urban problems with the arrival of migrants.

zh: 乡村迁移已不再是伊斯坦布尔的一种社会现象，但今天的城市仍以不同形式吸引迁入者。20世纪90年代末，伊斯坦布尔开始接收来自突厥诸共和国、非洲、亚美尼亚等地的国际移民。2013年以来，叙利亚难民的到来，成为城市迁移问题中最重要的话题。换言之，今天的城市里有新的“非伊斯坦布尔人”，他们面对的条件，比前几十年乡村迁入者所经历的更加严酷。如果反思城市权利小说，能够帮助我们从城市权利的视角看待当代城市生活，那么这不仅有益于那些面对日益严酷条件的人，也将有益于我们所有人。
en: Rural migration is no longer a social phenomenon in Istanbul, but the city today attracts migration in different forms. Towards the end of the 1990s, Istanbul started to receive international migrants: from the Turkic Republics, from Africa, Armenia and so forth. Since 2013, the arrival of Syrian refugees in the city has become the most important topic related to the issue of migration. In other words, today there are new ‘non-Istanbulites’ in the city facing harsher conditions than those experienced by rural migrants in earlier decades. If reflecting on the right to the city novels can help us view contemporary urban life through the perspective of the right to the city, it will be rewarding not only for those who face these increasingly harsh conditions but for all of us.
